Field containing the feature's height information. Any numeric field can be specified, and z-enabled features can also choose the geometry field. If the / option is chosen, z-values are interpolated from the surface.
Surface feature type that defines how the features contributes to the terrain.
Defines the group of each contributing feature.
Defines the range of pyramid resolutions at which the feature is enforced in the terrain. Mass points must use the smallest and largest range of values.
Defines the range of pyramid resolutions at which the feature is enforced in the terrain. Mass points must use the smallest and largest range of values.

Name of the embedded feature class. Only applies if the feature is being embedded. Use '/' for nothing.

member.remarks: This view model uses the PyramidLevels property as the source of truth for how the pyramid levels are defined. The PyramidLevelsVMs wrap a PyramidLevel and provide functionality to the UI to edit the levels. PyramidLevelVMs also contains two extra items, for the Full Resolution and Overview levels.
